observations: Photo 0 shows a large TV screen displaying a menu with 'SAMSUNG QLED 65Q77T' clearly visible on the left side of the screen.
The screen displays a colorful image with a man in a blue outfit, and the TV is mounted against a green textured wall.
Photo 1 shows the same TV displaying a smart TV interface with streaming apps like Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max, etc., and a featured content row.
Photo 2 shows the same TV with a different content screen, featuring 'Peacock Picks' and more streaming apps.
